test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II Official Paper-I (Held On: 20 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the following sentence in passive voice.

After we come to power at the Centre, we will conduct a countrywide caste census

options.text: A countrywide caste census should be conducted by us when we come to power at the Centre.
A countrywide caste census will be conducted by us as and when we come to power at the Centre.
A countrywide caste census will be conducted by us after we come to power at the Centre.
A countrywide caste census will have been conducted by us after we come to power at the Centre.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Passive voice structure:** The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "After we come to power at the Centre, we will conduct a countrywide caste census."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "a countrywide caste census" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "will conduct" to "will be conducted" (future simple passive).
 
• Add the preposition "**by**" followed by the original subject "us."
 
• Ensure the time phrase "after we come to power at the Centre" remains in the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"A countrywide caste census will be conducted by us after we come to power at the Centre."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"A countrywide caste census should be conducted by us when we come to power at the Centre." – Incorrect use of "should" instead of "will."
 
• **Option 2: **"A countrywide caste census will be conducted by us as and when we come to power at the Centre." – The phrase "as and when" is not typically used correctly in the context.
 
• **Option 4: **"A countrywide caste census will have been conducted by us after we come to power at the Centre." – Incorrect tense (future perfect passive).
